steps.title: Polygons — rules to know
steps.intro: \(n\) = number of sides. There really aren't many rules.

head: Rule
Formula
Remember
rows: the second form is on the formula sheet

tips: Regular = all sides AND all angles equal.
Regular ⇒ fits in a circle — but fitting in a circle does not make it regular.
Forgot an angle? Central angle \(\frac{360°}{n}\), then complete to \(180°\).

steps.stem: In pentagon ABCDE, angles B, C and E are right angles. Given: \(AB=BC=AE=12\) cm and \(DE=5\) cm, with AB parallel to CD. What is the area of the pentagon (in cm²)?
explanation: Triangle AED has perpendicular legs 12 and 5, so its area is 30 and AD=13. Drop AH perpendicular to CD. ABCH is a square of side 12. Triangle ADH has hypotenuse 13 and height 12, so DH=5 and its area is 30. The total is 144+30+30=204.

steps.stem: A regular hexagon has side length 8 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
explanation: Each central triangle has side 8 and area 8²√3:4=16√3. There are six, so the hexagon area is 96√3.

steps.stem: A regular octagon has side length 5 cm. What is its area (in cm²)?
explanation: The central square has area 25. Each corner right isosceles triangle has hypotenuse 5, so its legs are 5:√2 and its area 25:4. The four triangles total 25. Each rectangle has sides 5 and 5:√2 and area 25√2:2; four total 50√2. Altogether the area is 50+50√2.

steps.title: Polygon areas
steps.intro: No formula — split it into shapes you know.
tips: Octagon: the 4 corner triangles together = the middle square.
Hexagon: find one triangle — then don't forget to multiply by 6.

steps.stem: ABCDE is a regular pentagon. What is angle ADB?
explanation: Each pentagon interior angle is 108°. Triangles BCD and DEA have equal adjacent polygon sides and vertex angle 108°, so their base angles at D are 36° each. The requested angle is 108°−36°−36°=36°.

steps.stem: A regular octagon ABCDEFGH is inscribed in a circle with center O and radius r. Which of the following statements is not true?
choices: The perimeter of the octagon is \(8r\).
The circumference of the circle is greater than the perimeter of the octagon.
explanation: Each central triangle has vertex angle 45° and base angles 67.5°. The octagon side faces 45°, while each radius faces 67.5°. Thus each side is shorter than r and the perimeter is less than 8r, so equality is false.

steps.stem: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon. The perimeter of triangle ACE is 30 cm. What is the perimeter of the hexagon (in cm)?
explanation: Triangle ACE is equilateral, so AC=10. Triangle ABC is isosceles with vertex angle 120°. Its altitude from B bisects AC into 5 and 5 and forms a special right triangle. The hexagon side is 10:√3. Six sides give 60:√3=20√3.

steps.title: Regular polygons — facts to know
steps.intro: The shapes the exam loves, and the partitions that solve them fast.
tips: Corner triangle area \(=\frac{a^2\sqrt3}{4}\) — same as an equilateral triangle with the hexagon side \(a\).
Every extra side adds \(180°\) to the angle sum.
Regular polygon: a radius to a vertex bisects its angle; the diagonals from one vertex split it into equal pieces.
Octagon: square + 4 rectangles + 4 silver triangles (together = the square).

steps.stem: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon of side 6 cm. What is the sum of the areas of triangles ABC, CDE and EFA (in cm²)?
explanation: The three corner triangles together make half the hexagon. The whole area is 6×(6²√3:4)=54√3. Half is 27√3.

steps.stem: Four squares are constructed externally on four sides of a regular hexagon. Maya claims that the sum of the four square perimeters is 3 times the hexagon perimeter. Daniel claims that the sum of the four square areas is greater than the hexagon area. Which of the following is true?
explanation: Choose common side 3. The four square perimeters total 48, while the hexagon perimeter is 18;48 is not three times 18. The square areas total 36. The hexagon area is 27√3:2, which is less than 27 and hence less than 36. Only Daniel is correct.

steps.stem: The accompanying figure shows a regular octagon. AB and CD are perpendicular and intersect at E. A, B, C and D are vertices of the octagon, as shown in the figure. Lina claims that \(BE>2AE\). Noam claims that the perimeter of triangle ACE equals CD. Which of the following is true?
explanation: Let AE=CE=3. The octagon side AC is 3√2. BE=3+3√2>6=2 AE, so Lina is correct. The triangle perimeter is 6+3√2. Segment CD consists of two corner offsets of 3 and a middle length 3√2, also 6+3√2. Noam is correct too.

steps.stem: The accompanying figure shows a regular octagon divided by two vertical segments. The central white rectangle has area \(8+8\sqrt2\) cm². What is the sum of the shaded areas (in cm²)?
explanation: The white rectangle contains the central square and two of the four congruent rectangles. The shaded parts contain the other two rectangles and four corner triangles. The four triangles together equal the central square in area, so shaded and white totals are equal.

steps.stem: The sum of the interior angles of a polygon is 1,620°. How many sides does it have?
explanation: 180(n−2)=1620. Divide by 180 to get n−2=9, so n=11.

steps.stem: A is the sum of the interior angles of a 12-sided polygon, and B is the sum of the interior angles of a 17-sided polygon. The difference \(B-A\) equals the sum of the interior angles of which polygon?
explanation: B−A=180(17−2)−180(12−2)=180(15−10)=900°. A polygon with angle sum 900° has n−2=5, so n=7: a heptagon.

steps.stem: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon with side length 3 cm. AB and FE are extended to meet line CD at G and H, respectively. What is the perimeter of trapezoid AGHF (in cm)?
explanation: Each external base angle beside the hexagon is 60°, so triangles GBC and HED are equilateral with side 3. Thus AG=FH=6, GH=9 and AF=3. Their sum is 24.

steps.stem: The accompanying figure shows four congruent regular hexagons. Each has side length 2.4 cm. What is the distance AB (in cm)?
explanation: Along AB, the left and right hexagons each contribute a main diagonal of twice the side,4.8. The middle separation is one side,2.4. The total is 4.8+2.4+4.8=12.

steps.stem: Which polygon has an interior-angle sum of 900°?
explanation: 180(n−2)=900 gives n−2=5 and n=7, a heptagon.

steps.stem: The accompanying figure shows four congruent regular octagons surrounding a square opening. What is the ratio of the length of the outer boundary of the arrangement to the sum of the perimeters of the four octagons? (Do not include the boundary of the central opening.)
explanation: Each octagon contributes five sides to the outside boundary, giving 20 equal sides. The sum of the four full perimeters contains 32 sides. The ratio 20:32 reduces to 5:8.

steps.stem: Pentagon ABCDE consists of square BCDE of side 4 cm and triangle ABE. Given: \(AB=AE\) and angle BAE is 90°. What is the pentagon’s perimeter (in cm)?
explanation: BE=4 is the hypotenuse of a right isosceles triangle. Each roof side is 4:√2=2√2. The outside boundary contains three square sides and two roof sides, totaling 12+4√2.

steps.stem: Two congruent regular heptagons share one entire side and lie on opposite sides of it. The perimeter of their combined outer boundary is 84 cm. What is the perimeter of one heptagon (in cm)?
explanation: The shared side is absent from the outer boundary. There are 14−2=12 exposed equal sides. Each is 84:12=7 cm, so one seven-sided perimeter is 49 cm.

explanation: At each octagon vertex, the disk portion inside the polygon is a135° sector. The outside part is 225°, or 5:8 of the disk. Eight such portions total five full disks, giving 5×4π=20π.

steps.stem: In which of the following polygons do all the diagonals meet at a single point in the interior?
explanation: A parallelogram has exactly two diagonals, and they intersect at their common midpoint inside it. Thus all its diagonals meet at one interior point.

steps.stem: ABCDEF is a regular hexagon inscribed in a circle. The tangent at F meets the extension of BA beyond A at T. What is angle ATF?
explanation: Angle TAF is the exterior angle beside the hexagon’s120° interior angle, so it is 60°. The angle between tangent FT and chord FA is half the 60° arc FA, or 30°. Thus angle ATF=90°.

steps.stem: Six congruent rhombi meet at a common vertex and fill a full turn, with equal angles at that vertex. Each rhombus has perimeter 20 cm. The diagonals joining consecutive outer endpoints form the inner hexagon shown in the accompanying figure. What is its perimeter (in cm)?
explanation: Each central angle is 360°:6=60°. Each rhombus side is 20:4=5. The inner triangles have two equal sides 5 with included angle 60°, so they are equilateral. Each inner hexagon side is 5, giving perimeter 30.

steps.stem: The interior angles of a polygon sum to 1,980°. How many sides does the polygon have?

A regular decagon is divided into ten congruent triangles by joining its center to its vertices. On every other side, a congruent triangle is constructed externally. What is the outside angle α in the accompanying figure between one attached triangle and the adjacent decagon side?
explanation: A decagon interior angle is 144°. A central triangle has vertex angle 36° and base angles 72°. At the marked vertex, the outside triangle contributes 72°. The remaining angle is 360°−144°−72°=144°.

steps.stem: Pentagon ABCDE consists of rectangle BCDE and isosceles triangle ABE. Given: \(AB=AE=4a\), \(BC=a\), and angle BAE is 120°. What is the pentagon’s area?
explanation: The altitude of the 120° isosceles triangle creates two special right triangles with hypotenuse 4a. Its height is 2a, each half-base 2a√3, and BE=4a√3. The roof area is 4a²√3 and the rectangle area is also 4a²√3. Their sum is 8a²√3.

steps.stem: A regular octagon has side length 3 cm. The central square and the four adjoining rectangles in its standard partition are shaded. What is the total shaded area (in cm²)?
explanation: The central square area is 9. Each rectangle has sides 3 and 3:√2, so the four rectangles total 36:√2=18√2. The shaded total is 9+18√2.

steps.stem: Polygon P has \(n+1\) sides and polygon Q has \(m+3\) sides, with m and n being integers, \(m\ge3\), and \(n>m+2\). What is the interior-angle sum of P minus that of Q?
explanation: The sums are 180(n−1) and 180(m+1). Their difference is 180[(n−1)−(m+1)]=180(n−m−2).

steps.stem: A regular hexagon is inscribed in a circle. Its six short diagonals are tangent to a smaller circle with the same center. What is the ratio of the area of the larger disk to the area of the smaller disk?
explanation: A short diagonal subtends 120° at the common center. The perpendicular to it splits the isosceles triangle into 30°–60°–90° triangles, where the small radius is half the large radius. The radius ratio 2:1 gives area ratio 4:1.

steps.stem: A convex polygon is inscribed in a circle. Its sides divide the disk into 10 separate regions, including the polygon’s interior. How many sides does the polygon have?
explanation: Each polygon side cuts off one outside circular segment, and the polygon interior is one more region. Thus n+1=10 and n=9.

steps.stem: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 150°. How many sides does it have?
explanation: Each exterior turning angle is 180°−150°=30°. The full turn 360° therefore contains 12 equal angles.

steps.stem: Each interior angle of a regular polygon is 4 times its exterior turning angle. How many sides does it have?
explanation: Let the exterior angle be x. Its adjacent interior angle is 4x, so 5x=180° and x=36°. Dividing 360° by 36° gives 10 sides.

steps.stem: Exactly nine diagonals can be drawn from each vertex of a regular polygon. Its side length is 3 cm. What is its perimeter (in cm)?
explanation: From one vertex, the same vertex and its two neighbors do not give diagonals. Thus the count is n−3=9, so n=12. Twelve sides of 3 give perimeter 36.

steps.stem: A regular hexagon has area \(150\sqrt3\) cm². What is its perimeter (in cm)?
explanation: The area is 6×s²√3:4=3s²√3:2. Equating to 150√3 gives s²=100, so s=10 and perimeter 60.

steps.stem: In the standard partition of a regular octagon, the four corner right isosceles triangles have total area 49 cm². What is the octagon’s perimeter (in cm)?
explanation: The four corner triangles together equal the central square’s area, s². Thus s²=49, so the octagon side is 7 and its perimeter 8×7=56.

steps.stem: By how many degrees is an interior angle of a regular dodecagon greater than an interior angle of a regular octagon?
explanation: A dodecagon has 12 sides, so its interior angle is 180°−30°=150°. An octagon’s interior angle is 135°. Their difference is 15°.

steps.stem: A regular hexagon has area 96 cm². Three alternating vertices are joined to form a triangle. What is the area of this triangle (in cm²)?
explanation: Each corner triangle has one sixth of the hexagon area. Three take one half, leaving one half for the alternating-vertex triangle:48.
